scenarios.title: Normal production deploy — allowed
scenarios.narrative: Senior release engineer promotes a tagged release during business hours. Baseline risk, clean decision, permit issued.

scenarios.title: After-hours deploy from unfamiliar actor — denied
scenarios.narrative: A contractor service account with no deploy history attempts a production push at 2am, no MFA. Multiple risk factors fire; AtlaSent denies.

scenarios.title: Same deploy after MFA step-up + approver — allowed
scenarios.narrative: The contractor completes step-up auth and an on-call engineer approves in Slack. AtlaSent re-evaluates and allows with a short-lived permit.

scenarios.title: Regulated LIMS write — allowed, audit sealed
scenarios.narrative: A lab analyst posts an HbA1c result for a clinical sample. AtlaSent issues a single-use permit bound to the sample, assay, and analyst; the write is sealed into the audit trail on permit consume.

scenarios.title: Bulk clinical export without override — denied
scenarios.narrative: Same analyst tries to export 10,000 subject records to personal cloud storage. Separation of duties fires; AtlaSent denies and surfaces the override path.
